body:
Execute Ticket 6 (t-run2-w6-docs-website) for Release Audit Run 2.

IMPORTANT HEADLESS WORKER RULES:
- Use ONLY view_file, replace_file_content, and write_to_file.
- Do NOT call run_command (the scheduler automatically runs the test suite in the gating phase immediately after you finish editing).
- Only edit files in your declared scope.

1. In website/env-docs.json (lines 67-72) & website/generated/environment.mdx (line 13) (SHOULD-FIX #9):
   - In website/env-docs.json (lines 67-72), keep "default": "unset" and "bundledIgnored": false, and change "description" to:
     "Target repository path checked by bin/node-launcher.sh; any candidate Node binary whose realpath resolves inside AGB_TARGET_REPO (or the current working directory) is rejected to prevent repo-planted binary execution."
   - In website/generated/environment.mdx (line 13), replace the AGB_TARGET_REPO row with this exact line:
     | AGB_TARGET_REPO | unset | Target repository path checked by bin/node-launcher.sh; any candidate Node binary whose realpath resolves inside AGB_TARGET_REPO (or the current working directory) is rejected to prevent repo-planted binary execution. | honoured |

2. In website/generated/mcp-tools.mdx (lines 1-4):
   - Replace "No parameters." under "**`agb_doctor`**: Run diagnostic health check for tools, auth, and sandbox setup" with:
     | Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
     | --- | --- | --- | --- |
     | repo | string | no | Optional path to target repository |

3. In website/generated/slash-commands.mdx (line 8):
   - Replace "| /agb-run | /agb-run <plan.json> [options] | Execute a ticket DAG (build, gate, prosecute, merge) |" with:
     | /agb-run | /agb-run <plan.json> | Execute a ticket DAG (build, gate, prosecute, merge) |

4. In website/generated/skills.mdx (lines 4-5):
   - Prefix the Description column of the "release" (line 4) and "release-audit" (line 5) rows with "[Maintainer workflow for the antigravity-booster repository only] " so they match the updated SKILL.md frontmatter descriptions from Ticket 5.

5. In website/content/docs/reference/cli/run.mdx (line 13) and website/content/docs/reference/mcp-tools.mdx (line 19) (BACKLOG #14):
   - In website/content/docs/reference/cli/run.mdx (line 13), replace "it comes from the plan's `caps` and `concurrencyCap` fields" with "runtime concurrency is enforced by the plan's `caps` field (while `concurrencyCap` is an advisory fan-out forecast written by `adlc merge-forecast`)".
   - In website/content/docs/reference/mcp-tools.mdx (line 19), replace "Concurrency comes from the plan's `caps` and `concurrencyCap`." with "Runtime concurrency is enforced by the plan's `caps` field (while `concurrencyCap` is an advisory fan-out forecast written by `adlc merge-forecast`)."

6. In website/content/docs/index.mdx (line 16) (BACKLOG #16):
   - Update the flail-detector bullet to:
     - **Two-strike regeneration, gated by `adlc flail-detector`.** A failed first strike is regenerated from scratch with the failure diagnostic; if `adlc flail-detector` detects a repeated failure pattern, the second strike is halted before burning pool quota.
title: Fix AGB_TARGET_REPO documentation in website/env-docs.json, align CLI/MCP/landing docs, and synchronize website/generated/*.mdx
